protocol.purpose: Exploratory transfer check after shortcut state correction and optional training-only calibration
protocol.selection: last 30 percent of training commits only; strict function accuracy at 10 then MRR; default wins ties
protocol.holdout_rule: Do not change existing reports, labels, split, source scope or candidate grid based on holdout results
protocol.limitations: Existing holdout results have previously been inspected. This is exploratory, not a new untouched confirmation sample. No claimed rank or guaranteed improvement. Offline snapshot evaluation.

split_audit.query_hash: sha256 of lowercase whitespace-normalized title and body
split_audit.feedback: only training rows passed to learning operators; held-out labels used for scoring only

methodology.backend: offline in-memory structural graph; no HydraDB call
methodology.split: chronological by fix commit, unique issue IDs, last 40% held out (selected before any scoring to retain at least five held-out reports)
methodology.query: linked GitHub issue title and current body, truncated to 4000 characters by the shared ranker
methodology.graph: current source snapshot, scopes httpx; no co-change or held-out outcome edges
methodology.parameters: existing Django defaults transferred unchanged, no target-repository tuning
limitations: Exploratory sample, not a statistically established generalization result.
Retrospective current snapshot includes code from later fixes; issue bodies may have later edits.
GitHub closing references may include feature requests, not exclusively bugs.
Only mapped existing functions and PRs with explicit issue links are retained; selection bias applies.
Fix diff function mapping is a proxy for fault location, not a human-labelled root cause.
Does not establish hosted live graph learning or cross-repository generalization.

calibration.selection_rule: highest validation strict function accuracy@10, then MRR; default wins exact ties
